title: GAO Infrastructure Review 2026
text: The Government Accountability Office released its infrastructure spending report for fiscal year 2026. The report finds that infrastructure spending rose by roughly twelve percent over the prior period. Officials attribute the change to new appropriations and expanded programs. Auditors reviewed twenty-four sampled cases and identified three minor deficiencies. The document recommends stronger controls and quarterly reporting on infrastructure spending. A budget of five million dollars was allocated to the initiative. Stakeholders were consulted during a sixty-day comment window.
